6. Identify the Signatures: Include a place where signatures can be obtained, such as a notary public or online signature service. Make sure that all parties have the ability to sign the agreement.

7. Identify the Effective Date: Specify the date when the agreement becomes effective. This will help ensure that the agreement is enforceable and that all parties are aware of its terms.

8. Identify the Governing Law: Choose a governing law that applies to the agreement. This will help ensure that the agreement is interpreted consistently across different jurisdictions.

9. Identify the Dispute Resolution Process: Outline how disputes will be resolved if they arise. This could include mediation, arbitration, or litigation.

10. Limited Legal Protection: MLMs may face legal challenges if they violate anti-competition laws or other regulations.

3. Limited access to support networks
